items.detail_en: In the audio-visual room, for about 80 students: two classes (about 60) plus the 20 students in the international video-call course.
items.detail_zh: 在視聽教室，約 80 位學生：兩個班（約 60 位）加上國際視訊課程的 20 位同學。

items.detail_en: An interview with Principal Lai Pei-ling, joined by three or four members of the school's administrative team.
items.detail_zh: 專訪賴姵伶校長，3 到 4 位行政同仁一起受訪。
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」校長專訪系列。

items.detail_en: The 20 students in the international video-call course introduce their clubs to Dom: basketball and soccer, Nanguan and Beiguan music, the recorder ensemble, and the Vietnamese language and culture club.
items.detail_zh: 國際視訊課程的 20 位同學向 Dom 介紹學校社團：籃球、足球，南管、北管、直笛，以及越語社。
items.note_en: The students lead this one. Dom listens and asks questions.
items.note_zh: 這一節由學生主講，Dom 聆聽與提問。

footnote_en: Arranged with Principal Lai Pei-ling. The 8:15 lesson ties together the clubs the students will present at 10:05: sports for a healthy community, Nanbeiguan for heritage, and the recorder and Vietnamese clubs for a community where everyone belongs.
footnote_zh: 與賴姵伶校長安排。8:15 的課會先串起 10:05 同學要介紹的社團：運動讓社區健康、南北管守護文化、直笛與越語社讓每個人都有歸屬。
